e.title: SOA 精算 AI 思维与领导力
e.summary: SOA 研究报告：AI 时代的谦逊、判断与精算职业（AI 思维与领导力）
e.body:
SOA（北美精算师协会）研究报告「Actuarial AI Mindsets & Leadership」：AI 时代的谦逊、判断与精算职业——精算师在 AI 时代的思维与领导力研究。对 RIAA：精算 AI 思维与领导力的官方研究——与 [[soa-future-days-ai]]（Future Days 网播）、[[soa-practice-view-ai]]（实务网播）、[[soa-predictive-analytics-framework]]（预测分析框架）配套：SOA AI 研究/教育矩阵；理解「谦逊与判断」在 AI 时代的精算价值（AI 辅助下的专业判断）；精算职业的 AI 时代素养；面试/职业发展的思维谈资。

e.summary_hk: SOA 研究報告：AI 時代的謙遜、判斷與精算職業（AI 思維與領導力）
e.body_en:
The SOA (Society of Actuaries) research report 'Actuarial AI Mindsets & Leadership': humility, judgment and the actuarial profession in the age of AI — research on actuarial mindsets and leadership in the AI era. For RIAA: official research of actuarial-AI mindsets and leadership — with [[soa-future-days-ai]] (Future Days webcast), [[soa-practice-view-ai]] (practice webcast) and [[soa-predictive-analytics-framework]] (predictive-analytics framework) it forms the SOA AI research/education matrix; understand the actuarial value of 'humility and judgment' in the AI era (professional judgment with AI assistance); the AI-era literacy of the actuarial profession; mindset talking points for interviews and career development.
